subject.title: ignoreFileContent setting not working - file content still sent to model as context

question: Should Feishu gain a supported attachment-context opt-out, and should it follow an existing include-attachments style policy or a Feishu-specific media mode?
rationale: The reported key is not a current documented Feishu contract, and adding it changes channel config/default behavior for inbound attachments.

options.title: Add Backward-Compatible Opt-Out
options.body: Add a documented Feishu option that defaults to current media download behavior and switches to placeholder-only agent context when disabled.

options.title: Use Shared Channel Policy
options.body: Route Feishu through a broader channel media-ingestion policy if maintainers want one canonical attachment control across channels.

options.title: Document Unsupported Key
options.body: Clarify that Feishu currently supports mediaMaxMb only and does not provide a file-content ignore switch.

recommendation.title: Add Backward-Compatible Opt-Out
recommendation.body: Add a documented Feishu option that defaults to current media download behavior and switches to placeholder-only agent context when disabled.

likelyOwner.reason: The most relevant recent Feishu media/docs work is Tak Hoffman’s hardening change, making this the best available owner for the policy choice.
